listing.name: Dark Cloud 2 — DC2-PS2RECOMP (Red-tv141)
listing.summary: The project’s 0.9.5 release, published 2026-10-10 at 19:50:12 UTC, claims playable progress and improved frame rate and analog controls. steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Dark Cloud 2 NTSC-U USA SCUS-97213 v2.00 ISO or extracted disc tree; config documents ELF hash5c0bad0610323eaba6f06c8be8869de6 (hash algorithm unstated). Exact launcher import requirements need launcher-source inspection.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project publishes a player file in release 0.9.5. Its source configuration and PS2_PROJECT_STATE identify your own USA v2.00 game files. This guide has not confirmed the exact import route or package licensing and provenance; local source compilation is not the only described route.
